metrics.name: Functional verification status
metrics.definition: Boolean per attempt/task: output circuit is a +1 eigenstate of all k stabilizer generators (Stim TableauSimulator.peek_observable_expectation > 0 for each generator, generators zero-padded for ancillas). B3 additionally requires strictly higher FT than baseline.
metrics.collection_point: Verifier response to each candidate; final value taken from the retained best candidate.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Never imputed. Parse errors/timeouts/no result => status 'invalid' with failure_class set, distinct from 'not_run'. Baseline value absent => 'unavailable'.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined / repo-implemented

metrics.name: Preserved generators
metrics.definition: Number of generators g_j with g_j|psi> = +|psi>, out of k.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unavailable if verifier did not run; never 0 by default.
metrics.definition_origin: repo-implemented

metrics.name: Textual reproduction status
metrics.definition: Whether a regenerated circuit's NORMALIZED text equals the archived baseline circuit's normalized text (sha256 equality). Normalization = tools/check_stabilizers.py::preprocess_stim_text: unescape literal \n, strip lines, drop empty and '#' lines, collapse whitespace, single trailing newline.
metrics.collection_point: Offline comparison after a run; also usable on stored fixtures.
metrics.missing_data_policy: not_comparable if either side missing (e.g., baseline had no valid output). Never 'different' by default.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)
metrics.notes: LLM outputs are stochastic; 'different' is the expected result and does not indicate failure. Primary reproduction criterion is functional (above).

metrics.name: Structural reproduction status
metrics.definition: Whether two circuits have the same instruction sequence after expanding packed instructions into per-gate operations (gate name + ordered target tuple), ignoring tick/annotation lines. Weaker variant (reported separately): same multiset of (gate,targets) and same per-qubit gate order. Does NOT claim state equivalence.
metrics.missing_data_policy: not_comparable if either side missing.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Stabilizer-state equivalence
metrics.definition: Two circuits prepare the same stabilizer state (equal stabilizer tableaus up to the stabilizer group). Decided by Stim tableau comparison, not by gate order.
metrics.missing_data_policy: not_comparable if either circuit failed functional verification.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)
metrics.notes: Added because textual/structural identity is too strict for stochastic agents.

metrics.name: Total gate count (volume)
metrics.definition: Repo 'volume': number of gates from {H,S,X,Z,CX,CZ} after expanding packed instructions (SWAP not counted in volume though counted as two-qubit). Distinct from 'one_qubit_gates'+'two_qubit_gates' which count all gate names structurally.
metrics.collection_point: tools/circuit_metric.py::compute_metrics on every candidate (stored in B2 run records baseline_metrics/optimized_metrics).
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unavailable for B1/B3 stored records (not recorded). Compute offline from archived circuit only if circuit exists; else leave unavailable.
metrics.definition_origin: repo-implemented
metrics.notes: Paper does not define 'volume'; README RQ3 mentions 'circuit volume'.

metrics.name: Two-qubit gate count (G2Q)
metrics.definition: Number of multi-qubit entangling operations (CX, CZ, SWAP, ...) after expanding packed instructions. Stored as 'two_qubit_gates' (and 'cx_count' = CX only).
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unavailable if no circuit; never 0.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined / repo-implemented

metrics.name: Circuit depth
metrics.definition: Greedy-ASAP layer count with per-qubit last-layer tracking; TICK acts as a barrier (tick_is_barrier=True); annotations ignored. Paper: minimum time steps under maximum parallelism.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unavailable if no circuit.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined / repo-implemented
metrics.notes: Implementation is greedy per-qubit layer assignment; TICK is a barrier. Equivalence of this value to the paper's 'minimum time steps' wording is not verified.

metrics.name: B2 quality factor q_i
metrics.definition: q_i = 0.75*Delta_G2Q + 0.25*Delta_D, Delta_m = clip((b_m - o_m)/b_m, 0, 1); zero when the instance fails.
metrics.collection_point: Computed from baseline/optimized metrics at scoring time.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Failed instance => 0 contribution to S_qual (per Eq. 2), but also reported as 'failed' in per-instance table; baseline missing => unavailable.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined
metrics.notes: Re-derived exactly for Claude/GPT 15att/900s: S_cap 9,186/8,994; S_qual 2,911/2,757 from stored run files.

metrics.name: Fault-tolerance score FT(C)
metrics.definition: FT = 1 - (1/|T|) * #undetected dangerous single faults, T = single-fault variants whose propagated data-qubit error weight exceeds t=floor((d-1)/2). FT=1 if T empty; 0 if any flag ends in X/Y with no fault injected (implementation).
metrics.collection_point: check_fault_tolerance oracle on each B3 candidate; final = best valid candidate.
metrics.missing_data_policy: No B3 fixture selected in Week 1; baseline FT values unavailable until B3 stored records are reviewed. Missing => unavailable, never 0.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined / repo-implemented
metrics.notes: Paper text says rejection indicator pi; implementation docstring formula differs superficially; reconcile in Week 2.

metrics.name: Capability score S_cap
metrics.definition: S_cap = sum_i 1[success_i]*k_i over N=192 codes (k_i = generator count); max K=16,340.
metrics.collection_point: Aggregated from per-instance success at end of a full/partial run.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Partial runs: report only over attempted subset AND the subset's own maximum; never compare to the 16,340 ceiling.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined

metrics.name: Quality score S_qual
metrics.definition: S_qual = sum_i 1[success_i]*q_i*k_i.
metrics.missing_data_policy: As capability_score.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined

metrics.name: Perfect solve rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of attempted instances with success.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Denominator = attempted instances; state explicitly.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined

metrics.name: Number of generation attempts
metrics.definition: Count of attempt records for a task (one attempt = one candidate submitted to a verifier, consuming one unit of the attempt budget). IRIS-QEC may also create internal candidates that are never submitted; those are counted separately as internal_candidates.
metrics.missing_data_policy: B1 stored baselines: unavailable (not logged). B2: derivable from evaluations length.
metrics.definition_origin: benchmark-defined (budget) / PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark) (record)

metrics.name: Verifier invocations
metrics.definition: Number of oracle calls (check_stabilizers / evaluate_optimization / check_fault_tolerance), including any local diagnostic oracle calls made by IRIS-QEC epistemic actions (reported separately: budgeted_calls vs diagnostic_calls).
metrics.missing_data_policy: Baseline B1: unavailable. Missing => unavailable, never inferred from attempts.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)
metrics.notes: H3 (fewer LLM calls) needs budgeted vs diagnostic split to be fair.

metrics.name: Model calls
metrics.definition: Number of requests sent to a model API/harness per task. Streaming continuation and tool-result round trips each counted as one call.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Baseline: unavailable (not logged). Never estimated.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Input tokens
metrics.definition: Prompt tokens billed/reported by provider per call.
metrics.collection_point: Provider usage field copied verbatim into cost ledger.
metrics.missing_data_policy: Missing usage field => unavailable (not 0, not tokenizer estimate unless flagged cost_basis=estimated).
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Output tokens (incl. reasoning if billed together)
metrics.definition: Completion tokens reported by provider; reasoning tokens in separate field when provider reports them.
metrics.missing_data_policy: As above.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Wall-clock time
metrics.definition: Elapsed real time from task_start to task_end (per task) and run_start to run_end (per run). Baseline value = record 'elapsed_seconds' (harness-measured per code instance).
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unavailable if an endpoint event missing; timeouts recorded as the timeout value with failure_class=timeout.
metrics.definition_origin: repo-implemented (baseline) / PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark) (pipeline)

metrics.name: Local compute usage
metrics.definition: CPU-seconds (user+sys), peak RSS (MB), and GPU-seconds (expected 0) for local tool execution (Stim, classical synthesis).
metrics.missing_data_policy: Baseline: unavailable. Record host in run manifest so numbers are comparable.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Monetary cost
metrics.definition: Sum of (tokens x provider list price at the pricing snapshot date) per call, or provider invoice amount when available. Subscription-billed harness usage (Copilot) has no per-call price => unavailable for baselines.
source: provider pricing page captured with date
metrics.missing_data_policy: Never zero-filled. Totals carry complete=false if any entry unavailable.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)

metrics.name: Failure class
metrics.definition: Categorical: syntax_error, stabilizer_not_preserved, no_improvement, fault_tolerance_violation, excess_overhead, timeout, other, none.
metrics.collection_point: Assigned per attempt from verifier response + trace.
source: Midterm report (course document, kept outside this repo), section 6.5 step 4
metrics.missing_data_policy: Unclassified => 'other' with free-text note.
metrics.definition_origin: PROPOSED (Week 1; not defined by the benchmark)
